subject: Acme buying process & stakeholder mapping — exception request for SLA/discount
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Johnson <sarah.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Acme buying process & stakeholder mapping — next steps

Hi Sarah — great to speak earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery:

- Decision criteria you emphasized: latency under 250ms p95, predictable per-token pricing, ability to run in a private VPC for regulated workloads.
- Key stakeholders: Sarah Johnson (POC/product), Tom Lee (procurement), Michael Chen (security), and Angela Ortiz (finance/economic buyer). Can you confirm I captured that correctly?
- Procurement ask: Acme typically requires SOC 2 Type II evidence, standard indemnity language, and a procurement portal upload. You mentioned a two-week procurement window if we can provide SOC2 and a standard SLA.

A few items from our side:
- I attached the initial proposal and a suggested SOW for a pilot (Redwood_Proposal_v1.pdf).
- Tom and procurement asked whether we can accommodate a 99.9% SLA with a lower credit cap and a first-year promotional discount (they verbally requested ~25%). That would be outside our standard buying-process thresholds and would require internal approval.

Could you confirm the stakeholder list and procurement timeline? Also, would you be open to signing a pilot with DocuSign while procurement finishes paperwork (we can provide SOC2 evidence and a tightening of SLA credits)?

Next steps:
1) Sarah to confirm stakeholders and timeline (by EOW).
2) Redwood to request internal approval for the 25% first-year discount + SLA exception.
3) If approved, Redwood legal will send redline and DocuSign link.

Thanks — I’ll loop in the internal stakeholders to move the approval quickly.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0189

Attachments: Redwood_Proposal_v1.pdf

From: Tom Lee <tom.lee@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sarah Johnson <sarah.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: Sat, 21 Feb 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Acme buying process & stakeholder mapping — next steps

Marissa — thanks for the recap. Confirming procurement basics:

- We need SOC 2 Type II report and a support/SLA schedule. SOC2 is a gating item for our security team.
- Procurement prefers to run contracts through our portal; we can expedite if you provide a clear list of deliverables and the redline contract.
- Regarding discount: finance can consider a promotional credit for year one, but it needs exec sign-off from Angela (economic buyer).

If you can send the redline and SOC2, I’ll route to procurement and Angela. Timeline: procurement aims to complete review within 10 business days once SOC2 and the redline are received.

Tom
Senior Procurement Manager | Acme Corp
procurement@acme.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Acme buying process & stakeholder mapping — internal ask: approval for SLA/discount exception

Team — forwarding the thread with Acme. Quick summary of the ask and why I think we should approve an exception: 

- Deal: ACME-2026-23456; ARR potential (year 1) ~ $240k; growth upside across three lines-of-business.
- Ask from Acme: 25% first-year discount (promotional credit) + 99.9% SLA with a low credit cap (they requested limited credits).
- Why approve: customer is strategic in fintech vertical, strong reference potential, and likely to convert to Dedicated contract within 12 months. Speed to procurement is critical to close this quarter.

What I need from you:
1) Commercial approval for up to 25% promotional credit (confirm if finance needs a formal approval flow).
2) Legal guidance on SLA credit cap — can we offer 99.9% with a hard cap on credits or an alternative remedy?
3) Ops: confirm we can provide SOC2 evidence immediately (we have SOC2 A report attached).

I’ve attached the proposal and a draft redline (Redline_Contract_Acme.docx). If we can get a quick thumbs up from finance and legal, I’ll push DocuSign to Acme and ask Tom to start procurement.

Proposed timeline: internal sign-off by Tue 24 Feb so we can send DocuSign same day.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Marissa

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 08:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Acme buying process & stakeholder mapping — internal ask: approval for SLA/discount exception

Marissa — thanks for the context and the chase. High level: I’m supportive of pursuing the deal and agree strategic value is high. A few notes:

- Commercial: discount >20% requires VP-level approval in FY26; I can greenlight escalation to VP. Finance, please confirm the expected impact on CAC and if we want to attach a performance milestone to the promo.
- Legal: we should avoid open-ended SLA credit exposures. Suggest offering 99.9% SLA with a fixed annual credit cap equal to no more than 2x monthly MRR for year one. That should be acceptable to procurement while protecting us.
- Security/Ops: request the SOC2_ A report be uploaded to the procurement portal; if Acme needs an attestation letter, we can coordinate with Security.

Action items: Lauren to escalate to VP for discount approval (today). Aditya to confirm legal language for SLA cap and any required sign-off process. David to confirm SOC2 upload and timeline.

—Lauren

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Acme buying process & stakeholder mapping — internal ask: approval for SLA/discount exception

Marissa / team — legal and I have reviewed the ask. Summary of internal approval and conditions: 

- Discount: approved up to 25% promotional credit for year one, contingent on a signed DocuSign agreement and that the customer signs the standard Redwood data processing addendum.
- SLA: 99.9% SLA is acceptable; we will include a fixed annual credit cap equal to 2x monthly MRR for year one (per Lauren suggestion). No unlimited credits.
- SOC2: Security confirms SOC2_A_Report_2025.pdf is sufficient for procurement pre-review. Upload to procurement portal and provide a link.
- Approvals: Legal (Aditya Rao) signs off on the redline provided. Finance has been looped; any further escalation will be documented in the HubSpot deal.

I am attaching the redline for your reference. Please proceed to send DocuSign to Tom and Sarah with the agreed exceptions (discount and SLA cap). Keep me in the loop for the final signature.

Aditya
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com

Attachments: Redline_Contract_Acme.docx; SOC2_A_Report_2025.pdf
